searchText: <@592004585506340885> how hard it would be to get test vectors for EIP-8321? It can be either just on top of Gloas, or a feature fork. It would be pretty easy. But they aren't currently provided on github. You would clone the consensus-specs repo & run `make test reftests=true fork=eip8321`. The generated tests will be output to `reftests`. To be clear, you'll need to do this yourself 😅 we're not going to spend resources on eip8321 until it's CFI'd. But that’s just running your command? Nothing more? Yep, I believe that should be it!
